note: Thermal-state operator for a melt cell: it relaxes the cell toward whatever its own boundary contact is (the furnace floor, the ambient roof, or -- for an interior cell -- itself, since its only exchange is with neighbours through the conduction operator). The rate constant is the per-material law. Hand-authored illustrative map: it demonstrates the mechanism (Geant4 material facts -> conditions -> per-material operators) and carries no measured training domain, no scale band and no held-out accuracy (measured:false, teacher:none). The declared input mean/std are the intended operating range, so a run far outside it is honestly flagged as extrapolating; they are NOT a measured hull. It must never be described as glass-making metrology.
